title: Mobile wedding invitation builder
problem: Couples without design skills need to create and share a polished mobile wedding invitation page (date, venue, RSVP, gallery) quickly and affordably.
audience: Engaged couples in their 20s-30s planning a wedding, primarily on mobile, in Korea and similar markets.
coreTasks: Create an invitation from a template and personalize text, photos, and theme
Share the invitation link via messaging apps
Collect RSVP responses and congratulatory messages
Show venue location, directions, and account transfer info for gifts

features.name: Template gallery
features.description: Pre-designed invitation templates the user can pick and customize.

features.name: RSVP collection
features.description: Guests submit attendance, headcount, and meal preference.

features.name: Photo gallery
features.description: Couple photo gallery with lightbox viewing.

features.name: Venue map and directions
features.description: Embedded map, transit guidance, and parking info.

features.name: Gift account info
features.description: Bank account reveal for congratulatory money, per side of the family.

constraints: No paid screen-library sources may be used during research

brandConstraints.notes: Client-specified values override design-system default colors/fonts downstream; unspecified properties use the selected system's defaults.
